programme.title: Football: Conference League. SK Sigma Olomouc – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The Częstochowa team did their job in the match of the first round of the regular phase of the Conference League against Universitatea Craiova. They won 2-0 and could prepare for the away match against Sigma in peace. The team from Olomouc lost against Fiorentina 0:2

programme.title: Football: Conference League. NK Celje – Legia Warszawa
programme.desc: The club from the capital has two matches against difficult opponents. In the first match against Samsunspor (0:1) they failed to score points, but in the match against Shakhtar Donetsk the Military team won the full pool (2:1). Celje, on the other hand, has been flawless so far - first they beat AEK Athens and then Shamrock Rovers

programme.title: Football: Conference League. AC Sparta Prague – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: For the second time in this edition of the Conference League, the Medalists will face a representative of the Czech top league. In the second round of the league phase, SK Sigma Olomouc tested Marek Papszun's players. That match ended in a 1-1 draw. How will Rakov fare against Sparta Prague?

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Rayo Vallecano – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: In the 3rd series of matches of the regular round, a difficult test awaits Kolejorz, who will face Rayo Vallecano away. However, the Polish champion has a lot of experience when it comes to playing in European cups. He should approach the clash with the eighth force of the previous LaLiga season without any complexes and with faith in victory. Lech fans are counting on a repeat of 2022, when the Poznań locomotive won LK 3-0 against Villarreal

programme.title: Football: Conference League. KF Shkendija – Jagiellonia Białystok

programme.desc: When Sir David Attenborough, the British writer, traveler and popularizer of nature knowledge, turned 80, many thought it was the end of his career. However, it turns out that it was quite the opposite. Attenborough made a series of nature films examining the development of life on Earth, from its origins at the bottom of the ocean to the present day. He presents the results of his research in a series of documentary films... Great Britain. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Gladiators of the animal world – Waterhole | E01
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world. Drought forces animals to meet at a watering hole in southern Africa. This means that large and small species must live dangerously close to each other. Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Spring | E03
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Spring in Canada is a time when most animals breathe a sigh of relief after a cold winter. Unfortunately, spring is late this year. When it finally comes, there will be little time left to start a family. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Australia: saving animals – Arni – koala | E04
programme.desc: Dr Bree and her team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital rescue Australian animals in need of help. They treat a variety of creatures, from tiny echidnas to koalas and kangaroos. Koala Arni has an eye problem. Jasper the diamond python... ate the neighbor's cat. Six green sea turtles are returned to the wild. Australia. 2021. documentary series

His passion, intensity and vehemence have marked European basketball for more than thirty years. Zeljko Obradovic was a world champion as a player with a legendary Yugoslav team before making an early move to the bench. It was in 1991, with Partizan Belgrade, the team of his life. His first season he was already European champion. Joventut, Real Madrid, Treviso, Panathinaikos and Fenerbahçe later saw him triumph. Along the way he has marked the lives and careers of hundreds of players. Many call him teacher. Obradovic returned home, to Partizan, where they adore him. programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Dilla and Delilah (S2E9). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S2, Ep9
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep9 «Orangutan Jungle School»…The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother | Captivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School» | Cast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Land of Primates: Lemurs of Anja Mountain (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1 «Land of Primates»…Millions of years ago, castaway creatures found themselves stranded on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, the newcomers were left to evolve. This is a magical world of rare and unique creatures perfectly adapted to their tropical hideaway | This fascinating documentary series takes a close look at some of our closest relatives in the animal kingdom: the primates. Explore the characteristics, lifestyles and personalities of these resilient creatures as they face daily challenges in their quest for survival. The film crew visist Madagascar, home to several species of lemur, some found nowhere else on the planet, and we examine how they have adapted to the habitat of this unique island. In the heart of South Africa, an alpha male baboon has to protect his family from a dangerous rival gang. The Semien region of Ethiopia is home to geladas, mountain primates who overcome the difficulties of their rocky home. In Zanzibar, the colobus monkey face the threat of being hunted to extinction | Director: Claudio Velazques-Rojas, Jordan-Laine Calder

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 9 p.
programme.desc: Poppy was brutally attacked by a large dog. Tim tries to save Poppy the koala, who is unable to care for her baby. Audrey and Alison try to figure out why rescue cat Candy can't get up. Cast: Andrew Marchevsky, Chris Brown, Lisa Chimes, Tim Faulkner, Ben Dessen, Elissa Sursara, Dean Gladstone, Trent "Maxi" Maxwell, Steve Oemcke. Australia, 2009

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 10 s.
programme.desc: Gerardo must remove the ring that is embedded in Hector the Cockatoo's ankle. The Shens encounter the grumpy cat Rubens. It takes all of Tim's strength to help weigh the massive turtle. Cast: Andrew Marchevsky, Chris Brown, Lisa Chimes, Tim Faulkner, Ben Dessen, Elissa Sursara, Dean Gladstone, Trent "Maxi" Maxwell, Steve Oemcke. Australia, 2009

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries. Scorpios
programme.desc: Even Frankenstein could not even dream of creating such a perfect creature. He is like a mechanic, robots so efficient that they have been on Earth for over 400 million years. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Cast: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/f Where the soul lives. Indian elephants
programme.desc: In this series you will meet the Asian elephant - a symbol of wisdom. China, 2022

programme.title: d/f Wild Slovenia
programme.desc: Slovenia is a country full of natural contrasts. We will visit the majestic Alpine peaks, the hidden forests of the Dinaric Mountains, as well as the Pannonian plains and karst caves. Let's dive into the underground world and enjoy the views of the Adriatic Sea. More than 50 animal species are tracked throughout the year, showing different stages of their life cycle and environmental influences

programme.title: d/f Enchanted Kingdom 3D
programme.desc: The African wildlife documentary is the BBC's most ambitious and spectacular yet, filmed in 500 days. Using the latest 3D technology, the film presents viewers with unprecedented footage of the life of wild animals and ecosystems on this continent. Dir.: Neil Nightingale. Starring: Idris Elba, Lambert Wilson. UK, 2014

programme.title: d/f Wildlife of Lapland. Hills, polar night and northern lights
programme.desc: Lapland is not only a land of magical landscapes, but also home to many unique wild animals. In this film we take a journey through the northern hills to see them in their natural environment. The polar night, northern lights and midnight sun - all this will become the backdrop for the story of animals that live in one of the most extreme corners of the planet. Finland, 2024

programme.title: In the animal world. 47 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: In the animal world. 48 pp.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. programme.title: d/f Wildlife of Lapland. Autumn foliage, salmon river Tenojoki and the shores of the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lapland is not only a land of magical landscapes, but also home to many unique wild animals. In this film we take a journey through the northern hills to see them in their natural environment. The polar night, northern lights and midnight sun - all this will become the backdrop for the story of animals that live in one of the most extreme corners of the planet. Finland, 2024

programme.title: d/f Spain: paradise between two worlds
programme.desc: Our documentary will give you a glimpse into the wonderful world of feathered travelers. You will learn how Spain became the most important point on the map of migration routes, why such different species of birds stop here and what conditions provide them with comfortable living and breeding. Spain, 2024

programme.title: d/f Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The Caribbean archipelago is a chain of islands containing unique specimens of wildlife. Life took hold in this isolated environment, carried by winds, migrating birds or sea waves. Today these islands offer some of the richest biological resources in the world. This film explores this fascinating yet fragile wild Caribbean and its exceptional ecosystems. France, 2018

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wild nature. Predators of Africa
programme.desc: More or less direct descendants of dinosaurs, birds are divided into about 20 families that experts consider nonetheless fairly homogeneous. Africa is the best place to observe the often strange and impressive behavior of birds. France, 2014

programme.title: History of wildlife. Land of tigers and leopards
programme.desc: Previously, tigers and leopards were frequent inhabitants of the Korean Peninsula. Military conflicts and technological development have greatly affected their population. How did this affect the ecological status of the region? South Korea, 2020, educational

programme.title: d/s Such different animals. Up: giraffes, antelopes
programme.desc: In this series we will go to the world of the tall inhabitants of the savannah - giraffes and antelopes

programme.title: d/s Such different animals. Hide and seek game: leopard, panther, zebra, buffalo
programme.desc: In this series we explore the fascinating world of wildlife, meeting leopard, panther, zebra and buffalo

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild. Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Ideal hunters: dolphin traps, crocodiles patience, spider skills. What incredible abilities help predators survive. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. Czech Republic, USA, 2016

programme.title: d/f Italy. In places of wild nature. Mountain monks of Lesser Tibet
programme.desc: This episode explores the biological cycle of Apennine chamois, which are found only in the highest mountains of Central Italy. Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today they are under serious threat. 2023

programme.title: d/s Wild animals of Europe. Wild bocage
programme.desc: In a typical European countryside, wildlife is far more diverse than one might imagine, and it provides the backdrop for unexpected stories of survival. How do wild animals survive between agriculture and nature? France, 2018

programme.title: d/f Fearless Queen of the Night
programme.desc: The Ural owl is one of the largest owls in Europe and a mysterious nocturnal predator whose life is full of dangers and hidden secrets. In this film, we plunge into the world of this majestic bird, capable of attacking humans. Let's find out how she hunts in the night, what her features are and why she is so dangerous for those who find themselves next to her. Slovenia, 2024

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Madagascar
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/f Small forest nearby
programme.desc: In a world full of bustle and noise, there is a place where time flows slowly, and nature lives its measured life. The documentary will immerse you in a world of silence and harmony. Here, among the trees and grasses, live creatures invisible at first glance, whose lives are full of miracles and mysteries. Belgium, 2016

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 5 s.
programme.desc: The central part of China is the center of a civilization that is five thousand years old. This land is home to the giant panda, golden snub-nosed monkey and golden takin. China is facing environmental problems. 2018

programme.title: d/s The Fates of Animals. Mom giraffe
programme.desc: The film follows the life of a young female giraffe from the birth of her first calf to the birth of her second calf 20 months later. France, 2018

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 3 s.
programme.desc: The vast Tibetan Plateau is one of the most remote places in the world. It is home to chiru antelopes, wild yaks, foxes and bears, as well as a unique culture influenced by more than a thousand years of Buddhism. 2018

programme.title: d/s Inventions of nature. Life without water
programme.desc: This series tells us about microscopic creatures such as bacteria and lichens that can survive long periods of drought or survive without access to fresh water. Sweden, 2019

programme.title: d/s The most dangerous animals. North America
programme.desc: From dense forests and deserts to people's backyards, North America is home to many deadly creatures. Cast: Veronika Hyks. USA, 2007

programme.title: d/s Azure Monastery. 1 p.
programme.desc: The sea is vast and changeable. Due to the changing seasons, every living creature has to face endless cycles of various trials and struggle with all its might to survive and reproduce. 2021

programme.title: d/f Wild horses of France
programme.desc: A documentary about the wild horses that live in the Camargue nature reserve in France, which is the crown jewel of European wildlife. programme.title: Wild Mexico
programme.desc: It starts with the mountain worlds. The Sierra Madre is the highest and longest mountain range in Mexico. programme.title: MY RUN, MY WAY
programme.desc: Tập đầu tiên của 'My Run, My Way' bắt đầu dọc theo con đường Yeongdeok Blue tuyệt đẹp. Một chuyến đi độc đáo nơi Đại dương xanh, gió biển và mồ hôi của mọi người chạy đều tạo ra những khoảnh khắc khó quên.

programme.title: QUEEN'S HOUSE

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ĐỘI QUÂN MỘT NGƯỜI - ARMY OF ONE
programme.desc: Đặc vụ của Lực lượng đặc biệt Brenner và chồng tình cờ gặp một hợp chất ma túy bất hợp pháp trong rừng trong khi đi bộ đường dài. Những kẻ buôn bán ma túy bắt chúng, giết chồng và bỏ cô ấy chết. Brenner không chỉ trốn thoát còn sống, cô còn sôi sục với cơn thịnh nộ và thề sẽ săn lùng tất cả những người đã giết chồng và trả thù!

programme.title: BẠN CÓ ĐỦ BẢN LĨNH? - RUTE:TOUGHNESS REDEFINED
programme.desc: Cuộc thi trong khu vực đang phát triển đủ khó khăn đang tìm kiếm người khó khăn nhất từ ​​Đông Nam Á. Tham gia tìm kiếm và gặp gỡ một số cá nhân mạnh nhất về tinh thần và thể chất, dẫn đến một trận đấu cuối cùng hoành tráng ở Kuala Lumpur với giải thưởng trị giá 15.000 đô la Mỹ!

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, gia tộc Feather Black Feather đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và lấy trộm mặt nạ của Shura, do đó giải phóng một linh hồn xấu xa là một em bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn anh ta trở nên xấu xa. Khi em bé lớn lên, anh ta nắm quyền kiểm soát mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud, với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.
